question: By what means is the result attained, as addressed to the fair-faced one?
premises: An attainment is possible by this means.
That knowledge is also what has been heard.
The address is made to the fair-faced one.
inference: By this mere knowledge, which has been heard, attainment is possible, O fair-faced one.
uncertainties: Specific result not stated in this verse
plain_english: By this mere knowledge, which has been heard, O fair-faced one.
